comment: Excellent — gave us the exact supplier names and timelines we needed for the board deck. Saved 3 hours of research.
The re-routing plan was immediately actionable. We shared it with logistics ops and they confirmed the Hamburg corridor was correct.
Good risk register summary. Would have liked the dual-sourcing cost estimates broken out by supplier.
Forecast numbers matched our existing spreadsheet model closely — 92% accuracy. Team trusts this output now.
Contract reference to MLA clause 18.4 was correct. Slightly too formal in tone for a quick exec summary.
The working capital number (21.4%) was better than our own model (19%). Now using DHS as primary tool.
Output floor calculation was exactly right. Sent directly to Treasury team. Zero corrections needed.
TBML alert list matched our analyst team's assessment. Model caught Entity 3 (Horizon Tech HK) which our analyst had deprioritised — turned out to be the highest risk.
Stress test numbers consistent with our internal model to within 3%. Significant time saving on the SBP narrative.
CVA hedge recommendation was directionally correct. Needed our traders to verify the CDS notional sizing.
ICAAP HHI narrative was publication-ready. Edited for house style only. Saved half a day of analyst time.
Model risk summary accurately flagged all 4 models. Rating changes were consistent with our MVM committee decisions.
Segment list and churn probabilities were consistent with our Salesforce data. Confidence high.
SME vs retail NPS driver distinction was insightful. NPS numbers matched our survey vendor data.
Product recommendation with Consumer Duty suitability was immediately useful. Compliance team approved the output.
Journey funnel percentages were close to our GA4 data (within 2pp). Root cause hypotheses were actionable.
CLV comparison digital vs branch was eye-opening. Changed our marketing budget allocation decision.
Monthly dashboard summary was accurate. Used as the basis for the exec pack — minimal edits.
Critical role analysis was helpful. We were aware of Data Science gap but the quantification (0.8 successors/role) was new insight.
Attrition cost breakdown (£8.4M) was very close to our own finance team's estimate (£8.1M). Confidence very high.
DEI audit numbers matched our HR data. Promotion equity ratio gap for ethnic minority (0.76) is being escalated to board.
3-year workforce plan was used directly in the board paper. Very detailed and realistic phasing.
IR playbook was immediately deployed. SOC team said it was more comprehensive than our previous manual playbook.
Cloud migration risk ranking was correct. CorePayments high-risk flag was already on our radar.
Zero-trust contractor policy was NCSC CE+ compliant — confirmed by our external auditor.
Problem management summary was accurate. The overdue RCA P1-2024-0041 flag was correct.
Scope 3 Cat 1 calculation was within 5% of our third-party carbon accountant's figure. Accepted for disclosure.
Net-zero pathway capex numbers (£87M) aligned with our finance team's estimate. Milestone framework adopted.
Supplier ESG scoring identified ChemBase REACH violation we had not caught internally. Very high value alert.
TCFD section was assurance-ready. KPMG made only minor clarifications. Huge time saving vs previous year.
RCA for Line 7 coating failure was accurate — thermocouple calibration drift confirmed by our maintenance team. Model identified it 2h before our manual investigation.
OEE dashboard summary matched our SCADA system data. Improvement priorities were exactly right.
FS-03 bearing prediction: failure occurred 6.2 days after the alert (model said 8.4 day P50). Planned replacement completed successfully.
21 CFR Part 11 compliance summary was accurate for all 5 exceptions. QA director accepted output for regulatory file.
Target screen ranked PathogenIQ #1 — consistent with our investment bank's independent assessment. Useful validation.
Synergy model NPV and IRR matched our internal M&A team's model (NPV within £12M, IRR within 0.4%). Credible output.
Integration risk register was comprehensive. MHRA constraint was a risk we had not fully documented — now added to formal register.
Nexus Analytics PMI status was accurate. Revenue synergy shortfall analysis gave us the evidence to restructure the sales integration plan.
Microservices decomposition plan with strangler fig sequencing was adopted by our architecture team unchanged.
Data mesh design with 8 domain owners and 34 data products matched our architecture target. BCBS 239 constraint mapping was particularly useful.
AI governance framework with 3-tier risk classification was adopted as our official policy. SS1/23 alignment confirmed by second-line risk.
Technical debt quantification (£41M) was directionally correct. Our CAST assessment confirmed £38M — within 8%.
